coreResponsibility.summary: Interactive Video Quiz (IVQ) plugin for the Kaltura PlayKit JS Player that enables in-video quiz functionality with question overlays, scoring, submissions, and review capabilities.

featureOwnership: In-video quiz question rendering and management
Quiz question types: Multiple Choice, True/False, Multi-Answer, Open Question, Reflection Point
Quiz welcome screen and introduction flow
Quiz review screen with answer feedback
Quiz retake functionality with attempt tracking
Quiz cue point integration and synchronization
Quiz answer submission to Kaltura backend

stateManagement: QuizData - Quiz configuration and settings (welcomeMessage, canSkip, preventSeek, allowAnswerUpdate, attemptsAllowed)
QuizQuestion - Individual question state including answers, skip/seek availability, and navigation
QuizQuestionMap - Collection of all quiz questions mapped by ID
QuizUserEntry - User's quiz attempt tracking with score, version, and submission status
KalturaQuizAnswer - User's submitted answers with correctness indicators
dataObjects: KalturaQuizQuestion - Question content, type, optional answers, hints, explanations
KalturaQuizOptionalAnswer - Answer options with correctness and weight
QuizQuestionUI - UI-specific question state for rendering
SubmissionDetails - Quiz submission status and review callbacks

repositories.name: playkit-js-kaltura-cuepoints
repositories.purpose: Provides quiz cue point data and timed metadata events for question timing

repositories.name: playkit-js-timeline
repositories.purpose: Provides timeline service for adding quiz question markers on the player seekbar

repositories.name: kaltura-player-js
repositories.purpose: Core player framework, provides BasePlugin, UI components, event system, and provider for API calls

repositories.name: playkit-js-ui-managers
repositories.purpose: Provides FloatingManager for popups and ToastManager for notifications

services: Kaltura Backend API - quiz_quiz service for quiz data
Kaltura Backend API - userEntry service for user quiz attempts
Kaltura Backend API - cuepoint_cuepoint service for quiz answers

consumers: Kaltura Player applications embedding IVQ functionality
LMS integrations using Kaltura video quizzes

keyDirectories.components: src/components/ - UI components (quiz-question, quiz-review, quiz-submit, welcome-screen, ivq-popup)
keyDirectories.providers: src/providers/ - Kaltura API loaders (quiz-loader, quiz-answers-loader, quiz-submit-loader)
keyDirectories.translations: translations/ - i18n JSON files for 15 languages
